name: Academy Content Under The l10n Engine
greenMarker: Academy content passes the shared l10n gates
note: Roughly five thousand strings — strategy cards, diagram captions, practice missions — used to sit outside every l10n gate because the academy stores them with the axis inverted (item → locale, not locale → key). The engine could not be fed them, so nobody noticed the academy was using its own locale codes and serving Simplified Chinese to Traditional readers. This gate inverts the axis and runs the engine's own gate functions, so the two mutations below check that the inversion still reaches the data and that the imported rules still bite.

mutations.name: a Simplified character creeps into Traditional Chinese
mutations.why: This is the exact defect the academy shipped with for months: zh-TW readers served Simplified text. Gate 4 exists to catch it and was never shown this data. If swapping 後 for 后 here does not turn the gate red, the academy is outside the engine again — whatever the pipeline says.
mutations.find: "zh-TW": "📍 最後空格: 3x3 九宮格內的最後空格"
mutations.replace: "zh-TW": "📍 最后空格: 3x3 九宮格內的最后空格"

mutations.name: one language loses a string and the block ships incomplete
mutations.why: A missing key does not crash — the lookup falls back to English and renders. That silence is why partial translations survive: the screen looks fine to anyone who does not read the language. Gate 1 is the only thing that can see it, and it can only see it if the adapter is still handing over every locale.
mutations.find: "zh-TW": "📍 最後空格: 3x3 九宮格內的最後空格",

mutations.name: Japanese elimination target uses the wrong particle
mutations.why: J-04 must be detected in the academy corpus by the shared Gate 7.
mutations.find: 同じ行の他のマスにある 3 と 8 が消去対象になります。
mutations.replace: 同じ行の他マスから 3 と 8 が消去対象になります。
mutations.expectFailure: JA elimination target needs a location, not から (J-04)

mutations.name: Japanese caption turns a cell itself into a digit
mutations.why: J-06 distinguishes the cell from the digit placed in it.
mutations.find: 最後の空きマスに入る数字は、残った [9] に決まります。
mutations.replace: 最後の空きマスは自動的に残りの正解数字 [9] になります。
mutations.expectFailure: JA cell is confused with the digit placed in it (J-06)

mutations.name: a Hangul syllable left inside a Hindi academy title
mutations.why: The ChatGPT review of 2026-09-28 found नेके드 क्वाड — the last syllable Korean — in Hindi academy data that no gate read for Hangul. Gate 4 looked at ja only.

mutations.name: a French practice title loses the space before its colon
mutations.why: Found while checking Gemini's French review (2026-10-13): 84 academy practice titles read "Exemple pratique 1: …" — no space at all, which no reviewer counted because the UI scan never read the academy. Gate 10 runs here through the same corpus.
mutations.find: Exemple pratique 1 : Réduction bloc-ligne sur une ligne
mutations.replace: Exemple pratique 1: Réduction bloc-ligne sur une ligne

mutations.name: an Italian killer lesson writes perchè with a grave accent
mutations.why: The most common Italian spelling slip; gate 11 rule 4 runs over the academy here as well as over the UI.

mutations.name: a Hindi word inside an Italian academy sentence
mutations.why: Gemini's Italian review (2026-10-15) found this exact word in the Hidden Triple description — 「Elimina tutti gli अन्य candidati」. No gate saw it: gate 4 is a deny-list of CJK pairs. Gate 12 allows each locale only its own scripts plus Latin.
mutations.find: gli altri candidati da quelle tre caselle
mutations.replace: gli अन्य candidati da quelle tre caselle
